## Change and reason

Describe the concrete behavior and integration impact.

## Validation

List relevant passing checks and any evidence still pending.

- [ ] Public API diff reviewed; migration notes for breaking changes
- [ ] Examples/DocC and independent regression expectations updated where relevant
- [ ] No raw text, private assets or hidden telemetry introduced
- [ ] Model/policy/pattern changes include versions, rights and evaluation evidence
- [ ] Golden changes explicitly identified for dedicated review

Do not mark device, pilot or release gates passed using simulator or historical
results for a different candidate. Link the exact release record when applicable.
